WITH hs_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    s.ncessch,
    s.sch_name,
    s.gr_span_low,
    s.gr_span_high,
    s.gr_low_enroll,
    s.gr_high_enroll,
    s.status,
    s.ncesdist,
    -- String comparisons to order grades: 'PK'<K<1<2...
    CASE
      WHEN s.gr_low_enroll = 'PK' THEN 0
      WHEN s.gr_low_enroll = 'KG' THEN 1
      WHEN CAST(s.gr_low_enroll AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 2
      WHEN CAST(s.gr_low_enroll AS INTEGER) > 1 THEN 1 + CAST(s.gr_low_enroll AS INTEGER)
      ELSE 100 -- catch-all for odd cases
    END AS gr_low_rank
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.ncesdist = '0613360'
    AND s.status = '1'
    AND (s.gr_span_high = '12' OR s.gr_high_enroll = '12')
    AND s.gr_high_enroll = '12' -- must actually enroll students in grade 12
),
sat_free_hs AS (
  SELECT h.ncessch, h.sch_name, h.gr_span_low, h.gr_span_high, h.gr_low_enroll, h.gr_high_enroll, h.gr_low_rank
  FROM hs_candidates h
  LEFT JOIN satscores ss ON ss.ncessch = h.ncessch
  WHERE COALESCE(ss.num_testtakers, 0) = 0
)
SELECT sch_name, gr_span_low, gr_span_high
FROM sat_free_hs
WHERE gr_low_rank = (SELECT MIN(gr_low_rank) FROM sat_free_hs)
ORDER BY sch_name;

WITH district_high_schools AS (
  SELECT 
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.GSoffered,
    s.GSserved,
    s.StatusType,
    s.NCESDist
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.NCESDist = '0613360'
    AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND s.GSserved LIKE '%12%'
),

sat_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.cds,
    SUM(sc.NumTstTakr) AS total_takers
  FROM satscores sc
  GROUP BY sc.cds
),

with_sat_join AS (
  SELECT 
    dh.CDSCode,
    dh.school_name,
    dh.GSoffered,
    dh.GSserved,
    IFNULL(sc.total_takers, 0) AS total_takers
  FROM district_high_schools dh
  LEFT JOIN sat_counts sc ON dh.CDSCode = sc.cds
  WHERE IFNULL(sc.total_takers, 0) = 0
),

--- Parse GSserved (e.g., 'KG-12', '09-12', 'PS-12', etc.)
min_grade AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(CASE 
          WHEN substr(GSserved, 1, 2) = 'PS' THEN 0
          WHEN substr(GSserved, 1, 2) = 'KG' THEN 1
          WHEN substr(GSserved, 1, 2) = 'TK' THEN 2
          ELSE CAST(substr(GSserved, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
        END) AS min_start_grade
  FROM with_sat_join
)

SELECT 
  wsj.school_name, 
  wsj.GSserved
FROM with_sat_join wsj
CROSS JOIN min_grade mg
WHERE (
  CASE 
    WHEN substr(wsj.GSserved, 1, 2) = 'PS' THEN 0
    WHEN substr(wsj.GSserved, 1, 2) = 'KG' THEN 1
    WHEN substr(wsj.GSserved, 1, 2) = 'TK' THEN 2
    ELSE CAST(substr(wsj.GSserved, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
  END
) = mg.min_start_grade
ORDER BY wsj.school_name ASC
LIMIT 100

SELECT 
    School_Name, 
    [School Type], 
    Latitude 
FROM schools
WHERE 
    State = 'CA'
    AND (
        -- School Type indicates middle school
        LOWER([School Type]) LIKE '%middle%' 
        OR LOWER([School Type]) LIKE '%junior high%'
        -- Or the school name contains "middle" (matches question's logic)
        OR LOWER(School_Name) LIKE '%middle%'
        OR LOWER(School_Name) LIKE '%junior high%'
    )
    AND Latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(Latitude) != ''
    -- Only real coordinates

LIMIT (
    -- Find number of top-latitude ties
    SELECT COUNT(*) 
    FROM schools s2
    WHERE 
        State = 'CA'
        AND (
            LOWER([School Type]) LIKE '%middle%'
            OR LOWER([School Type]) LIKE '%junior high%'
            OR LOWER(School_Name) LIKE '%middle%'
            OR LOWER(School_Name) LIKE '%junior high%'
        )
        AND s2.Latitude = (
            SELECT MAX(CAST(Latitude AS REAL)) 
            FROM schools s3
            WHERE 
                s3.State = 'CA'
                AND (
                    LOWER([School Type]) LIKE '%middle%'
                    OR LOWER([School Type]) LIKE '%junior high%'
                    OR LOWER(School_Name) LIKE '%middle%'
                    OR LOWER(School_Name) LIKE '%junior high%'
                )
                AND s3.Latitude IS NOT NULL
                AND TRIM(s3.Latitude) != ''
        )
        AND s2.Latitude IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(s2.Latitude) != ''
)

WITH active_charters AS (
  SELECT
    s.school_id,
    s.school_name,
    s.charter_funding AS funding_category,
    s.status AS school_status,
    s.k12_enr_2014_15 AS enrollment_2014_15,
    s.k12_frpm_pct_2014_15 AS frpm_pct_2014_15
  FROM
    schools s
  WHERE
    s.charter_funding IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
    AND s.status = 'Open'
    AND s.charter_flag = 1
),
sat_scores AS (
  SELECT
    sc.school_id,
    COALESCE(ss.avg_reading, 0) + COALESCE(ss.avg_math, 0) + COALESCE(ss.avg_writing, 0) AS combined_sat
  FROM
    satscores ss
    JOIN schools sc ON ss.school_id = sc.school_id
  WHERE
    ss.avg_reading IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.avg_math IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.avg_writing IS NOT NULL
),
charters_with_sat AS (
  SELECT
    ac.school_id,
    ac.funding_category,
    ac.enrollment_2014_15,
    ac.frpm_pct_2014_15,
    sat.combined_sat
  FROM
    active_charters ac
    LEFT JOIN sat_scores sat ON ac.school_id = sat.school_id
)
SELECT
  funding_category,
  COUNT(*) AS num_active_charter_schools,
  SUM(enrollment_2014_15) AS total_enrollment_2014_15,
  ROUND(AVG(frpm_pct_2014_15), 2) AS avg_frpm_pct_2014_15,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN combined_sat IS NOT NULL THEN combined_sat END), 2) AS avg_combined_sat
FROM
  charters_with_sat
GROUP BY
  funding_category
ORDER BY
  funding_category
;

  FROM satscores
  WHERE AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL AND AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
),

  SELECT
    b.FundingType,
    COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
    SUM(b.enrollment) AS total_enrollment,
    ROUND(AVG(b.frpm_pct),2) AS avg_frpm_pct

    SELECT awd.*, dist.A3 AS district_name, dist.A2 AS district_city, dist.A4 AS region, dist.A10 AS population
    FROM acct_with_district awd
    LEFT JOIN district dist ON awd.client_district_id = dist.district_id
),
-- Sum of all loan amounts ever borrowed per account
loan_amount_sum AS (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_borrowed
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
-- All transfers for these accounts (outbound and inbound), only with other banks (k_symbol IN ('POJISTNE', 'SLUZBY', 'UROK', 'SANKC. UROK', 'UVER', 'PREVOD'))
relevant_trans AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.trans_id, t.operation, t.k_symbol, t.amount, t.account2, t.bank
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM borrowing_accounts)
      AND t.account2 IS NOT NULL
      AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
      AND t.account2 != '' AND t.bank != '' -- must be interbank
      AND t.operation IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') -- incoming/outgoing transfer
),
acct_counterparty_count AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT account2 || '-' || bank) AS outside_counterparty_count
    FROM relevant_trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
final_table AS (
    SELECT
        awp.acct_no,
        awp.acct_open_date,
        IFNULL(las.total_borrowed, 0) AS total_borrowed,
        IFNULL(accp.outside_counterparty_count, 0) AS outside_counterparty_count,
        awp.client_district_id AS home_district_id,
        awp.district_name AS home_district,
        awp.population AS home_district_population
    FROM acct_with_pop awp
    LEFT JOIN loan_amount_sum las ON awp.account_id = las.account_id
    LEFT JOIN acct_counterparty_count accp ON awp.account_id = accp.account_id
)
SELECT
    acct_no,
    acct_open_date,
    total_borrowed,
    outside_counterparty_count,
    home_district,
    home_district_population,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY home_district_population DESC, acct_no ASC) AS population_rank
FROM final_table
ORDER BY home_district_population DESC, acct_no ASC;

WITH gold_cards AS (
  SELECT card.card_id, card.disp_id, disp.account_id
  FROM card
  JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
  WHERE card.type = 'gold' AND disp.type = 'OWNER'
),
avg_balances AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM trans t
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
eligible_accounts AS (
  SELECT gc.account_id, disp.client_id
  FROM gold_cards gc
  JOIN avg_balances ab ON gc.account_id = ab.account_id
  JOIN disp ON gc.account_id = disp.account_id
  WHERE ab.avg_balance > 1000 AND disp.type = 'OWNER'
),
account_branches AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
  FROM account a
),
qualified_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ab.district_id
  FROM eligible_accounts ea
  JOIN account_branches ab ON ea.account_id = ab.account_id
  JOIN district d ON ab.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE d.inhabitants > 100000
),
district_by_gender AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, d.name AS district_name, d.inhabitants, d.avg_salary, d.ratio_urban, c.gender
  FROM qualified_districts qd
  JOIN district d ON qd.district_id = d.district_id
  JOIN account_branches ab ON d.district_id = ab.district_id
  JOIN eligible_accounts ea ON ab.account_id = ea.account_id
  JOIN client c ON ea.client_id = c.client_id
),
per_gender AS (
  SELECT
    gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT district_id) AS num_districts,
    MAX(inhabitants) AS max_inhabitants
  FROM district_by_gender
  GROUP BY gender
),
top_districts AS (
  SELECT gender, district_id, district_name, inhabitants
  FROM (
    SELECT
      gender,
      district_id,
      district_name,
      inhabitants,
      RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY inhabitants DESC) as rn
    FROM district_by_gender
    GROUP BY gender, district_id
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
avg_salary_urban AS (
  SELECT
    gender,
    ROUND(AVG(DISTINCT avg_salary),2) AS avg_salary,
    ROUND(AVG(DISTINCT ratio_urban),2) AS avg_urban_ratio
  FROM district_by_gender
  GROUP BY gender
)
SELECT
  g.gender,
  p.num_districts,
  t.district_name AS most_inhabited_district,
  t.inhabitants AS most_inhabitants,
  a.avg_salary,
  a.avg_urban_ratio
FROM per_gender p
JOIN top_districts t ON p.gender = t.gender AND p.max_inhabitants = t.inhabitants
JOIN avg_salary_urban a ON p.gender = a.gender
WHERE g.gender = 'F'
UNION ALL
SELECT
  g.gender,
  p.num_districts,
  t.district_name AS most_inhabited_district,
  t.inhabitants AS most_inhabitants,
  a.avg_salary,
  a.avg_urban_ratio
FROM per_gender p
JOIN top_districts t ON p.gender = t.gender AND p.max_inhabitants = t.inhabitants
JOIN avg_salary_urban a ON p.gender = a.gender
WHERE g.gender = 'M'
ORDER BY gender, most_inhabitants DESC, most_inhabited_district;

WITH gold_card_owners AS (
    SELECT
        c.client_id,
        c.gender,
        a.account_id,
        a.district_id as branch_district_id
    FROM card ca
    JOIN disp d ON ca.disp_id = d.disp_id
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE ca.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER'
),
account_avg_balance AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans t
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
qualified_accounts AS (
    SELECT
        gco.*
    FROM gold_card_owners gco
    JOIN account_avg_balance aab ON gco.account_id = aab.account_id
    WHERE aab.avg_balance > 1000
),
qualified_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        qa.gender,
        a.district_id AS district_id
    FROM qualified_accounts qa
    JOIN account a ON qa.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 > 100000
),
district_stats AS (
    SELECT
        qd.gender,
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS inhabitants,
        d.A11 AS avg_salary,
        d.A13 AS ratio_urban_inhabitants
    FROM qualified_districts qd
    JOIN district d ON qd.district_id = d.district_id
),
max_inhabitants AS (
    SELECT
        gender,
        MAX(inhabitants) AS max_inhabitants
    FROM district_stats
    GROUP BY gender
)
SELECT
    ds.gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ds.district_id) AS num_districts,
    ds_max.district_id AS district_with_most_inhabitants,
    ds_max.inhabitants,
    ROUND(AVG(ds.avg_salary), 2) AS avg_salary,
    ROUND(AVG(ds.ratio_urban_inhabitants), 2) AS avg_ratio_urban_inhabitants
FROM district_stats ds
JOIN max_inhabitants mi
    ON ds.gender = mi.gender
JOIN district_stats ds_max
    ON ds_max.gender = mi.gender AND ds_max.inhabitants = mi.max_inhabitants
GROUP BY ds.gender, ds_max.district_id, ds_max.inhabitants
ORDER BY ds.gender, ds_max.district_id

WITH big_city_branches AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.inhabitants >= 250000
),
gold_owners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND c.type = 'gold'
),
eligible_accounts AS (
    SELECT b.account_id
    FROM big_city_branches b
    INNER JOIN gold_owners g ON b.account_id = g.account_id
),
payments_1998 AS (
    SELECT 
        t.account_id, 
        t.bank, 
        t.account AS counter_account, 
        t.amount
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.date >= 19980101 AND t.date <= 19981231
      AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM eligible_accounts)
      AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
      AND t.account IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    p.bank AS recipient_bank_code,
    p.counter_account AS recipient_counter_account_number,
    COUNT(*) AS number_of_outgoing_payments,
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount_paid
FROM payments_1998 p
GROUP BY p.bank, p.counter_account
HAVING SUM(p.amount) = (
    SELECT MAX(total_paid)
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_paid
        FROM payments_1998
        GROUP BY bank, counter_account
    )
)
ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC
;

WITH gold_owner_accounts AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.district_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND c.type = 'gold'
),
large_district_accounts AS (
    SELECT
        goa.account_id
    FROM gold_owner_accounts goa
    JOIN district dt ON goa.district_id = dt.district_id
    WHERE dt.A11 >= 250000
),
filtered_trans AS (
    SELECT
        t.bank,
        t.account AS counter_account,
        t.amount
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM large_district_accounts)
      AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
      AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
      AND t.account IS NOT NULL
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        bank,
        counter_account,
        COUNT(*) AS num_payments,
        SUM(amount) AS total_paid
    FROM filtered_trans
    GROUP BY bank, counter_account
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_paid DESC) AS rnk
    FROM aggregated
)
SELECT
    bank AS recipient_bank_code,
    counter_account,
    num_payments,
    total_paid
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY recipient_bank_code, counter_account;

WITH pisek_branches AS (
  SELECT a.account_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE d.district_name = 'Pisek'
),
outgoing_with_purpose AS (
  SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.amount, t.k_symbol
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_branches)
    AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    AND t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
),
total_with_purpose AS (
  SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount
  FROM outgoing_with_purpose
),
sipo_with_purpose AS (
  SELECT SUM(amount) AS sipo_amount
  FROM outgoing_with_purpose
  WHERE k_symbol = 'SIPO'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * sipo_with_purpose.sipo_amount / total_with_purpose.total_amount, 2) AS sipo_percentage
FROM total_with_purpose, sipo_with_purpose;

WITH female_owner_clients AS (
    SELECT 
        c.client_id, 
        c.district_id, 
        d.account_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND d.type = 'OWNER'
),
clients_with_card AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.client_id, f.district_id, f.account_id
    FROM female_owner_clients f
    JOIN card ca ON ca.disp_id = (
        SELECT disp_id 
        FROM disp 
        WHERE account_id = f.account_id 
          AND client_id = f.client_id 
        LIMIT 1
    )
),
clients_with_card_and_loan AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.district_id, c.account_id
    FROM clients_with_card c
    JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = c.account_id
),
districts_with_target_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, di.region
    FROM clients_with_card_and_loan d
    JOIN district di ON d.district_id = di.district_id
),
region_district_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        di.region,
        di.district_id,
        di.A96_average_salary AS avg_salary,
        di.A96_unemploymant_rate AS unemployment_rate,
        di.A96_inhabitants AS inhabitants,
        di.name AS district_name
    FROM district di
    JOIN districts_with_target_clients t 
        ON di.district_id = t.district_id
),
region_stats AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        ROUND(AVG(avg_salary), 2) AS avg_district_salary,
        ROUND(AVG(unemployment_rate), 2) AS avg_district_unemployment,
        -- get most populous district per region
        district_name AS most_populous_district,
        inhabitants
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            region, 
            avg_salary, 
            unemployment_rate, 
            inhabitants,
            district_name,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY region 
                ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_name ASC
            ) as rn
        FROM region_district_agg
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
    GROUP BY region, district_name, inhabitants
)
SELECT 
    region,
    avg_district_salary,
    avg_district_unemployment,
    most_populous_district
FROM region_stats
ORDER BY region;

WITH female_owner_disp AS (
    SELECT disp.disp_id, disp.account_id, client.district_id
    FROM client
    JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
    WHERE client.gender = 'F' AND disp.type = 'OWNER'
),
cards_per_account AS (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    GROUP BY d.account_id
),
loans_per_account AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM loan
),
qualified_accounts AS (
    SELECT fod.account_id, fod.district_id
    FROM female_owner_disp fod
    WHERE fod.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM cards_per_account)
      AND fod.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM loans_per_account)
),
qualified_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT q.district_id
    FROM qualified_accounts q
),
d_profile AS (
    SELECT district.district_id, district.A2 AS region, district.A3 AS name, 
           district.A7 AS inhabitants, district.A11 AS avg_salary, district.A10 AS unemployment_96
    FROM district
    WHERE district.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM qualified_districts)
),
region_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        region, 
        AVG(avg_salary) AS avg_district_salary, 
        AVG(unemployment_96) AS avg_unemployment_96
    FROM d_profile
    GROUP BY region
),
populous_district AS (
    SELECT region, name AS most_populous_district
    FROM (
        SELECT region, name, CAST(replace(inhabitants, ',', '') AS INT) AS inhabitants_num
        FROM d_profile
    ) pd1
    WHERE (pd1.region, pd1.inhabitants_num, pd1.name) IN (
      SELECT pd2.region, MAX(pd2.inhabitants_num), MIN(pd2.name)
      FROM (
        SELECT region, name, CAST(replace(inhabitants, ',', '') AS INT) AS inhabitants_num
        FROM d_profile
      ) pd2
      GROUP BY pd2.region
    )
)
SELECT 
    rs.region, 
    ROUND(rs.avg_district_salary, 2) AS avg_district_salary, 
    ROUND(rs.avg_unemployment_96, 2) AS avg_unemployment_96,
    pd.most_populous_district
FROM region_stats rs
JOIN populous_district pd ON rs.region = pd.region
LIMIT 1000
;

WITH central_bohemia_districts AS (
    SELECT code, name, inhabitants
    FROM district
    WHERE LOWER(region) = 'stredocesky'
),
top3_cb_districts AS (
    SELECT code, name, inhabitants
    FROM central_bohemia_districts
    ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, name COLLATE NOCASE ASC
    LIMIT 3
),
cb_1996_crime AS (
    SELECT d.name, d.inhabitants, d.code,
           d96.crimes_1996
    FROM top3_cb_districts d
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT code, crimes_95_96 AS crimes_1996
        FROM district
    ) d96 ON d.code = d96.code
),
cb_1996_avg AS (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG(crimes_1996*1.0), 2) AS avg_1996_crime_top3
    FROM cb_1996_crime
),
all_districts_1996 AS (
    SELECT name, crimes_95_96 AS crimes_1996
    FROM district
),
all_1996_avg AS (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG(crimes_1996*1.0), 2) AS avg_1996_crime_all
    FROM all_districts_1996
)
SELECT 
    c.name AS district_name,
    c.inhabitants,
    c.crimes_1996,
    cb_1996_avg.avg_1996_crime_top3,
    all_1996_avg.avg_1996_crime_all,
    ROUND(cb_1996_avg.avg_1996_crime_top3 - all_1996_avg.avg_1996_crime_all, 2) AS difference_top3_vs_all
FROM cb_1996_crime c
CROSS JOIN cb_1996_avg
CROSS JOIN all_1996_avg
ORDER BY c.inhabitants DESC, c.name COLLATE NOCASE ASC
;

WITH districts_central_bohemia AS (
  -- Central Bohemia districts have 'A2' = 'Stredocesky'
  SELECT
    district_id,
    A2 AS region,
    A3 AS district_name,
    A4,
    A8 AS inhabitants,
    A11 AS crimes_1996
  FROM district
  WHERE A2 = 'Stredocesky'
),
top3_districts AS (
  SELECT
    district_id,
    district_name,
    inhabitants,
    crimes_1996
  FROM districts_central_bohemia
  ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_name COLLATE NOCASE ASC
  LIMIT 3
),
top3_avg AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(crimes_1996 * 1.0), 2) AS avg_3
  FROM top3_districts
),
all_districts_avg AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(A11 * 1.0), 2) AS avg_all
  FROM district
)
SELECT
  t.district_name,
  t.inhabitants,
  t.crimes_1996,
  (SELECT avg_3 FROM top3_avg) AS avg_crimes_top3_1996,
  (SELECT avg_all FROM all_districts_avg) AS avg_crimes_all_1996,
  ROUND((SELECT avg_3 FROM top3_avg) - (SELECT avg_all FROM all_districts_avg), 2) AS diff_top3_minus_all
FROM top3_districts t
ORDER BY t.inhabitants DESC, t.district_name COLLATE NOCASE ASC;

WITH card_types AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT type FROM card
  WHERE type IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')
),
card_client_district AS (
  SELECT
    c.type AS card_type,
    d.district_id,
    d.name AS district_name,
    d.inhabitants
  FROM card c
  JOIN disp dp ON c.disp_id = dp.disp_id
  JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id
  JOIN district d ON cl.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE c.type IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')
),
min_inhabitants_per_card_type AS (
  SELECT
    card_type,
    MIN(inhabitants) AS min_inhabitants
  FROM card_client_district
  GROUP BY card_type
)
SELECT
  ccd.card_type,
  ccd.district_name,
  ccd.inhabitants
FROM card_client_district ccd
JOIN min_inhabitants_per_card_type minc
  ON ccd.card_type = minc.card_type
  AND ccd.inhabitants = minc.min_inhabitants
ORDER BY ccd.card_type, ccd.district_name

WITH card_types AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT type FROM card
),
client_districts AS (
    SELECT
        c.type,
        cl.district_id
    FROM
        card c
        JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
        JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
),
district_inhabitants AS (
    SELECT
        ct.type,
        cd.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A3 AS inhabitants
    FROM
        card_types ct
        JOIN client_districts cd ON ct.type = cd.type
        JOIN district d ON cd.district_id = d.district_id
),
min_inhabitants AS (
    SELECT
        type,
        MIN(inhabitants) as min_inhabitants
    FROM
        district_inhabitants
    GROUP BY
        type
)
SELECT
    di.type AS card_type,
    di.district_name,
    di.inhabitants
FROM
    district_inhabitants di
    JOIN min_inhabitants mi ON
        di.type = mi.type
        AND di.inhabitants = mi.min_inhabitants
ORDER BY
    di.type, di.district_name

WITH litomerice_region AS (
  SELECT region
  FROM district
  WHERE district_name = 'Litomerice'
  LIMIT 1
), acc_1996 AS (
  -- Accounts opened in 1996 in the region of Litomerice, with their districts.
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  JOIN litomerice_region lr ON d.region = lr.region
  WHERE a.date_opened >= '1996-01-01' AND a.date_opened <= '1996-12-31'
), last_trans AS (
  -- For accounts opened in 1996, get the last transaction on or before 1996-12-31
  SELECT
    t.account_id,
    t.trans_id,
    t.balance
  FROM (
    SELECT
      account_id,
      MAX(trans_date) AS last_date
    FROM trans
    WHERE trans_date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
  ) ltd
  JOIN trans t
    ON t.account_id = ltd.account_id AND t.trans_date = ltd.last_date
  -- If multiple transactions on that date, pick the one with max trans_id
  WHERE t.trans_id = (
    SELECT MAX(trans_id) FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = t.account_id AND trans_date = t.trans_date
  )
), acc_balances AS (
  SELECT
    a.account_id,
    d.district_name,
    d.region,
    COALESCE(lt.balance, 0) AS end1996_balance -- Assume 0 if no transaction up to end 1996
  FROM acc_1996 a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  LEFT JOIN last_trans lt ON a.account_id = lt.account_id
), stats_by_district AS (
  SELECT
    district_name,
    COUNT(*) AS num_accounts_1996,
    ROUND(AVG(end1996_balance), 2) AS avg_end1996_balance
  FROM acc_balances
  GROUP BY district_name
)
SELECT
  sbd.district_name,
  sbd.num_accounts_1996,
  sbd.avg_end1996_balance,
  region_avg.region_wide_avg_end1996_balance,
  max_district.max_avg_district_name
FROM stats_by_district sbd
JOIN (
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(end1996_balance), 2) AS region_wide_avg_end1996_balance
  FROM acc_balances
) region_avg
JOIN (
  -- District with max average balance (alphabetical if tie)
  SELECT district_name AS max_avg_district_name
  FROM stats_by_district
  WHERE avg_end1996_balance = (SELECT MAX(avg_end1996_balance) FROM stats_by_district)
  ORDER BY district_name ASC
  LIMIT 1
) max_district
ORDER BY sbd.district_name ASC;

WITH litomerice_region AS (
    SELECT A3 AS region
    FROM district
    WHERE A2 = 'Litomerice'
    LIMIT 1
),
districts_in_region AS (
    SELECT district_id, A2 AS district_name
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = (SELECT region FROM litomerice_region)
),
accounts_1996 AS (
    SELECT 
        a.account_id,
        a.district_id,
        a.date AS account_open_date
    FROM account a
    WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1996'
),
accounts_1996_in_region AS (
    SELECT 
        a.account_id,
        d.district_name,
        d.district_id
    FROM accounts_1996 a
    JOIN districts_in_region d
        ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
end_of_1996_tx AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        t.trans_id,
        t.date,
        t.balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.date <= '1996-12-31'
),
latest_tx_per_account AS (
    SELECT
        e.account_id,
        e.balance
    FROM end_of_1996_tx e
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            account_id,
            MAX(date) AS max_date
        FROM end_of_1996_tx
        GROUP BY account_id
    ) max_dt
        ON e.account_id = max_dt.account_id AND e.date = max_dt.max_date
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            account_id,
            date,
            MAX(trans_id) AS max_tid
        FROM end_of_1996_tx
        GROUP BY account_id, date
    ) max_tid
        ON e.account_id = max_tid.account_id AND e.date = max_tid.date AND e.trans_id = max_tid.max_tid
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        air.account_id,
        air.district_name,
        ltp.balance
    FROM accounts_1996_in_region air
    LEFT JOIN latest_tx_per_account ltp
        ON air.account_id = ltp.account_id
)
SELECT
    f.district_name,
    COUNT(f.account_id) AS accounts_opened_1996,
    ROUND(AVG(f.balance), 2) AS avg_end_1996_balance,
    (SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) FROM final WHERE account_id IS NOT NULL) AS region_avg_end_1996_balance,
    (SELECT district_name FROM (
        SELECT district_name, ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) AS avg_end_1996_balance
        FROM final
        WHERE account_id IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY district_name
    ) d

        -- birth_number: YYMMDDxxxx

        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_number, 3, 2) > '54'
                THEN '19' || SUBSTR(c.birth_number, 1, 2)
                ELSE '19' || SUBSTR(c.birth_number, 1, 2)
            END

        ) AS year_birth,
        CAST(

WITH drivers_with_duplicate_forenames AS (
  SELECT forename
  FROM drivers
  GROUP BY forename
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
relevant_drivers AS (
  SELECT driverId
  FROM drivers
  WHERE code IS NULL
    AND forename IN (SELECT forename FROM drivers_with_duplicate_forenames)
),
qualifying_1_under_2_minutes AS (
  SELECT q1
  FROM qualifying
  WHERE driverId IN (SELECT driverId FROM relevant_drivers)
    AND q1 IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      /* q1 times are stored as mm:ss.sss or h:mm:ss.sss or NULL; we must convert to seconds. */
      -- Convert 'm:ss.sss' to seconds and check < 120
      (
        INSTR(q1, ':') = 2 AND
        CAST(SUBSTR(q1, 1, INSTR(q1, ':')-1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(q1, INSTR(q1, ':')+1) AS FLOAT) < 120
      )
      OR
      -- Convert 'mm:ss.sss' to seconds and check < 120
      (
        INSTR(q1, ':') = 3 AND
        CAST(SUBSTR(q1, 1, INSTR(q1, ':')-1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(q1, INSTR(q1, ':')+1) AS FLOAT) < 120
      )
      OR
      -- If it's less than 120 when treated as pure seconds (rare/edge case)
      (
        q1 NOT LIKE '%:%' AND CAST(q1 AS FLOAT) < 120
      )

        -- Dipstick grade with mg/dL in parentheses, e.g. '+2(100)'
        OR
        (l2.result LIKE '%(%)' AND
          CAST(
            SUBSTR(
              l2.result,
              INSTR(l2.result, '(') + 1,
              INSTR(l2.result, ')') - INSTR(l2.result, '(') - 1
            ) AS INTEGER
          ) >= 100
        )
      )

  COALESCE(ca.num_carbon, 0) AS num_carbon,
  COALESCE(cl.num_chlorine, 0) AS num_chlorine,
  COALESCE(ctb.num_carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS num_carbon_touching_bonds,
  COALESCE(mb.num_multiple_bonds, 0) AS num_multiple_bonds,
  RANK() OVER (
    ORDER BY COALESCE(ctb.num_carbon_touching_bonds, 0) DESC,
             COALESCE(a.num_atoms, 0) DESC,
             m.id ASC
  ) AS rank
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN atom_counts a ON m.id = a.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN bond_counts bc ON m.id = bc.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN carbon_atoms ca ON m.id = ca.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN chlorine_atoms cl ON m.id = cl.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN carbon_touching_bonds ctb ON m.id = ctb.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN multiple_bonds mb ON m.id = mb.molecule_id
WHERE COALESCE(ca.num_carbon, 0) >= 1
ORDER BY
  num_carbon_touching_bonds DESC,
  num_atoms DESC,
  molecule_id ASC
;

WITH
atom_counts AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_carbon_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_chlorine_atoms,
        COUNT(*) AS num_atoms
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT
        b.molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS num_bonds,
        -- Carbon-touching bonds: join bond to atoms twice, counting once per bond if at least one end is carbon
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN a1.element = 'C' OR a2.element = 'C' THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS num_carbon_touching_bonds,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN b.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple') THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS num_multiple_bonds
    FROM bond b
    -- atom1_id and atom2_id are not given, so instead we cannot resolve which atom is which; unused in this DB
    -- So, carbon-touching bond count cannot be determined exactly without further schema or data
    -- Fallback: count all bonds as not carbon-touching (yields 0 for all)
    -- This block remains here for completeness, but will not count actual carbon-touching bonds without more schema
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE 1=0 -- Prevent cross join explosion, as correct key not present
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
)
SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label AS carcinogenicity,
    COALESCE(a.num_atoms, 0) AS num_atoms,
    0 AS num_bonds,
    COALESCE(a.num_carbon_atoms, 0) AS num_carbon_atoms,
    COALESCE(a.num_chlorine_atoms, 0) AS num_chlorine_atoms,
    0 AS num_carbon_touching_bonds,
    0 AS num_multiple_bonds,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            0 DESC,
            COALESCE(a.num_atoms, 0) DESC,
            m.molecule_id ASC
    ) AS rank_position
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN atom_counts a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
-- Not joining bond_counts, as calculation is not possible without atom mapping in bond table
WHERE COALESCE(a.num_carbon_atoms, 0) >= 1
ORDER BY
    num_carbon_touching_bonds DESC,
    num_atoms DESC,
    m.molecule_id ASC
;

WITH non_carc_mols AS (
  SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '-'
),
double_triple_bonds AS (
  SELECT bond_id, molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type IN ('double', 'triple')
),
bonds_in_noncarc AS (
  SELECT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id FROM double_triple_bonds b JOIN non_carc_mols m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
),
bond_connections AS (
  SELECT c.bond_id, a1.element AS elem1, a2.element AS elem2 FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    WHERE a1.element != a2.element
),
carb_elem_bonds AS (
  SELECT bc.bond_id, bc.elem1, bc.elem2 FROM bond_connections bc
    WHERE (bc.elem1 = 'C' OR bc.elem2 = 'C')
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN elem1 = 'C' THEN elem2 ELSE elem1 END AS element,
  COUNT(*) AS bond_count
FROM
  carb_elem_bonds cb
  JOIN bonds_in_noncarc bnc ON cb.bond_id = bnc.bond_id
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY bond_count DESC, element

WITH atom_bond_info AS (
  SELECT
    a.id AS atom_id,
    a.element,
    COUNT(b.id) AS total_bonds,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 END) AS single_bonds,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN b.bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 END) AS multiple_bonds
  FROM atom a
  JOIN bond b ON a.id = b.atom1_id OR a.id = b.atom2_id
  GROUP BY a.id, a.element
)

  element,
  COUNT(atom_id) AS saturated_atom_count
FROM atom_bond_info
WHERE
  total_bonds > 0 -- exclude atoms with no bonds
  AND multiple_bonds = 0 -- never part of any multiple bond
  AND total_bonds = single_bonds -- all bonds are single
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element ASC;
